title: Assessing and Refining ChatGPT's Performance in Identifying Targeting and Inappropriate Language: A Comparative Study
abstract: arXiv:2505.21710v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This study evaluates the effectiveness of ChatGPT, an advanced AI model for natural language processing, in identifying targeting and inappropriate language in online comments. With the increasing challenge of moderating vast volumes of user-generated content on social network sites, the role of AI in content moderation has gained prominence. We compared ChatGPT's performance against crowd-sourced annotations and expert evaluations to assess its accuracy, scope of detection, and consistency. Our findings show that ChatGPT performs well in detecting inappropriate content, and that almost the entire gain from iterative prompt refinement came from a single change --- simplifying the label scheme and moving to GPT-4 --- after which further adjustments to prompt structure and sampling temperature had little effect. translated_title: 评估与改进ChatGPT在识别定向攻击性言论和不当言论方面的表现：一项比较研究
translated_abstract: 本研究评估了ChatGPT这一先进的自然语言处理AI模型在识别网络评论中定向攻击性言论与不当言论方面的有效性。随着社交网络平台上海量用户生成内容审核挑战的日益加剧，AI在内容审核中的作用愈发重要。我们将ChatGPT的表现与众包标注和专家评估进行了比较，以评估其准确性、检测范围和一致性。研究结果表明，ChatGPT在检测不当内容方面表现良好，且迭代式提示词优化所带来的提升几乎全部来自单次更改——即简化标签方案并转向GPT-4——此后对提示结构和采样温度的进一步调整几乎没有效果。其在定向攻击性言论识别方面的表现较弱且不够稳定，与专家判断相比存在较高的误报率……
tldr: 研究发现ChatGPT在检测不当言论方面表现良好，且提示词优化带来的提升几乎全部来自简化标签方案并升级至GPT-4这一单次更改，但其在识别定向攻击性言论方面表现较弱、稳定性较差且误报率较高。
en_tdlr: ChatGPT performs well in detecting inappropriate language, with nearly all gains from iterative prompt refinement coming from a single change—simplifying the label scheme and moving to GPT-4—while its performance on targeting language remains weaker, less stable, and prone to higher false positive rates than expert judgments.
